name: UIFlow
description: Adaptive-UI Flow (plan-38/43, WS1). A guarded multi-step graph over Views — e.g. an 'Add Task' form that on success routes back to the list. Design-time authored in Trillo AI (TrilloMD row with modelClassName="UIFlow"), versioned + GitHub-syncable + promotable; the deploy flattens each authored content blob into this queryable per-app table via DeployAppMetadata.bootstrapUIFlows (upsert by uid, reconcile orphans). AOS serves it read-only via /ui/flow/{uid} (role-scoped, returns the flow + its Views via UIView.parentUID). The flow's step Views live in UIView (WHERE parentUID = this uid); flat, no nesting. dataApi: open + admin read-only ACL keeps generic CRUD off (edits in Trillo AI, ship via redeploy); the serve-API reads via raised-privilege DataStore.

attributes.name: uid
attributes.description: Stable identifier for this Flow — the deploy upsert key and the value UIView.parentUID points at. Equals the authoring TrilloMD row's name. Composite unique on (tenantId, uid), enforced at the application layer.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Primary serving key — the role this Flow is served to. Coarse exec role (guest/user/admin/system) or an app role name; the serve-API filters on it.

attributes.name: appRoles
attributes.description: Optional JSON array of additional app-role names this Flow is also served to (secondary gate beyond `role`).

attributes.name: entryViewUid
attributes.description: The UIView.uid the flow starts at. Its remaining step Views are UIView rows WHERE parentUID = this flow's uid.

attributes.name: transitions
attributes.description: JSON payload — the guarded transition graph between the flow's Views (e.g. on a Form's Direct-API success, a guarded then.goto to another View). Interpreted by the frontend; not queried.
